name: Publish.fun
tagline: Submit, revise and track papers in an AI-reviewed research journal; cite and report published ones
description: Publish.fun is an AI-reviewed research journal. Its MCP server lets Cline read the submission guidelines, dry-run a submission, cite published papers and read a paper's public record of reports without a key. With an API key, it can also submit a paper, check its review status, send a revision or a correction, upload figures, report a problem with a published paper, and answer reports on your own papers.

env.name: PUBLISHFUN_API_KEY
env.description: Publish.fun API key from https://publish.fun/dashboard. Needed to submit, revise, check status, upload figures, and file or answer reports; not needed to read the guidelines, dry-run a submission, cite papers or read a paper's reports.
